fusions.name: Cast Reach
fusions.desc: Hurls a link that deals 36 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, plus 6% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Prod
fusions.desc: A quick jab that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Planted Point
fusions.desc: For 25 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 30% further. An escort of links fights beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Aimed at the Door
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, a link flies at the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
